handoff_instructions: M2-T11 done. Changed files: packages/domain/src/types.ts (added "communication" to ENTITY_TYPES so a task's polymorphic entity_type/entity_id can reference the communications table, the same pattern already used for customer/job/etc.); packages/core/src/services/entities.ts (added communication -> public.communications to ENTITY_TABLES so assertEntityInOrg validates it's in the caller's org); packages/domain/src/schemas.ts (added createCallbackTaskInput zod schema + CreateCallbackTaskInput type: communicationId, title, description, priority, dueAt, assignedUserId); packages/core/src/services/tasks.ts (added createCallbackTask(ctx, input), a thin wrapper that parses input and calls the existing createTask with entityType: "communication", entityId: communicationId - authorization (task.create, already permitted for the 'agent' actor type), the same-org entity check, and the task.created event/audit all come from createTask, so no logic was duplicated); packages/core/test/callback-tasks.test.ts (new: verifies a callback task links to its call/communication, is audited with actor_type='agent' and a task.created event, rejects a communication from a different organization with NotFoundError, and denies a field_employee actor lacking task.create with ForbiddenError). No idempotency key was added to callback tasks, matching createTask's existing behavior (tasks are not idempotent-keyed like leads; only external side effects require it under CLAUDE.md rule 7, and creating an internal task is not one). pnpm lint / typecheck / test all pass (packages/core: 151 tests incl. the 3 new ones). Next: M2-T12 "Agents package and receptionist definition".
